codes.ERR_MALFORMED_JSON: The input is not valid JSON (parse failure before structural checks).
codes.ERR_TOP_LEVEL_NOT_OBJECT: The metadata document root is not a JSON object.
codes.ERR_UNKNOWN_TYPE: A node uses a type not registered in the registry.
codes.ERR_UNKNOWN_SUBTYPE: A node uses a subType not valid for its type.
codes.ERR_MISSING_SUBTYPE: A node omits subType and the type has no default subType.
codes.ERR_DUPLICATE_NAME: Two sibling nodes share the same name.
codes.ERR_UNRESOLVED_SUPER: An extends/super reference names a node that does not exist.
codes.ERR_INVALID_SUBTYPE_CHILD: A child node type/subType is not permitted under its parent.
codes.ERR_UNKNOWN_ATTR: An attribute name is not declared on the node's type.
codes.ERR_MISSING_REQUIRED_ATTR: A required attribute is absent from the node.
codes.ERR_BAD_ATTR_VALUE: An attribute value fails its declared schema (type/range).
codes.ERR_BAD_DEFAULT_SORT_FIELD: A layout @defaultSortField names a field absent from the entity.
codes.ERR_PROVIDER_DEPENDENCY_CYCLE: Provider composition has a dependency cycle.
codes.ERR_PROVIDER_DUPLICATE_ID: Two providers in a composition share the same id.
codes.ERR_PROVIDER_MISSING_DEPENDENCY: A provider declares a dependency id with no matching provider.
codes.ERR_PROVIDER_ATTR_CONFLICT: A provider extend redefines an attr another provider already declared.
codes.ERR_SUBTYPE_RULE_VIOLATION: A node violates a subtype composition rule (e.g. a value object with a primary identity).
codes.ERR_OVERLAY_NO_TARGET: An overlay node has no existing target to merge into.
codes.ERR_MALFORMED_YAML: The YAML metadata input is not valid YAML, or cannot be desugared into canonical metadata.
codes.ERR_INVALID_ORIGIN: A field origin (passthrough/aggregate) declares an invalid path or attribute.
codes.ERR_INVALID_TEMPLATE: A template (prompt/output) declares a @payloadRef that does not resolve, or @requiredSlots that are not fields on its payload.
codes.ERR_BAD_ATTR_FILTER: A dataGrid @filter references a non-filterable field or uses an op disallowed for the field's subtype.
codes.ERR_STORAGE_WITHOUT_OBJECT_REF: @storage was set on a field that has no @objectRef.
codes.ERR_UNKNOWN: An internal loader error with no stable error code.
